Marks awarded 0 Difficulty - Attempt% - Correct% - Your time 6 Avg time - Letters: Q → S → U → W → Y. Letters increase by +2 in alphabetical order. Numbers: 1 → 2 → 6 → 21 → ?. Each number is multiplied by increasing factors: 1×2=21 \times 2 = 21×2=2, 2×3=62 \times 3 = 62×3=6, 6×3.5=216 \times 3.5 = 216×3.5=21, 21×3.5=6621 \times 3.5 = 6621×3.5=66.
